issue.input_source: NCEP operational GFS 1.0-degree analyses and 0-6 hour forecasts for 2026-08-17 and 2026-08-18; experimental proxy for ERA5-initialized FuXi-S2S
issue.scientific_status: Experimental GFS-proxy initialization; no matched GFS-initialized hindcast calibration is available.

initial_condition_source.label: GFS operational proxy
initial_condition_source.description: Near-real-time operational analyses and short-range forecasts aggregated into the model's two daily input states. Experimental.

climatology_alignment.operation_order: interpolate each yearly native-ensemble mean, aggregate seven lead days, then equally average 20 years

observation_verification.message: Verification is withheld until every required observation day in a valid week is available.

wind850_climatology_alignment.operation_order: interpolate each yearly 51-member vector mean, aggregate seven lead days, then equally average 20 years

wind850_provenance.definition: shading: ensemble-mean vector speed minus the equally weighted mean of 20 yearly vector speeds; arrows: forecast U/V mean minus the 2002-2021 U/V model climatology

grid.value_order: latitude-major row order; latitude is north-to-south

rainfall_anomaly.description: Weekly-mean forecast minus lead-matched model climatology

temperature_anomaly.description: Weekly-mean forecast minus lead-matched model climatology
